product.description: Self‑attaching hook and loop material, popularized by the NASA space program, is a "miracle" fastener with thousands of uses, from hanging a picture on a wall to replacing a traditional zipper on a jacket to almost anything you can imagine. This roll of hook and loop material is just what you need for that special project.
